text: Nde kulol hoɓɓe ɓen iwunoo e Annabi Ibraahiima, ɓaawo nde o anndude ɓe ñaamatah ko ɓe Malaaka enwelo-welo jibingol Ishaaqa refti Yaaquuba ngol ari e makko, o wattini himo wennjida e Nulaaɓe Amen ɓen fii yimɓe Luuti ɓen, fii no ɓe tonngiranee lepte ɗen, belajo'o ɓe daɗnda Luuti e yimɓe makko ɓen.
